author: littlepalehorse
description:
Penpot is the first open-source design and prototyping platform meant for cross-domain teams.

Penpot allows teams to design, prototype, and develop together in one place. It is browser-based, works with open standards (SVG, CSS, HTML), and runs on self-hosted infrastructure — giving you full control over your design data.

**Main Features:**
- Open-source design platform (SVG-based)
- Real-time collaboration for designers and developers
- Prototyping with interactions and animations
- Design tokens and variables for consistent branding
- Self-hosted — full data sovereignty
- Plugin system and MCP (Model Context Protocol) support

**Learn More:**
- [Penpot Official Website](https://penpot.app)
- [Penpot GitHub](https://github.com/penpot/penpot)
- [Penpot Documentation](https://help.penpot.app)
tagline: Open-source design and prototyping platform for cross-domain teams.

tips.before_install:
**Important:** After first install, change `PENPOT_SECRET_KEY` and `PENPOT_DATABASE_PASSWORD` to secure values. The default key is insecure.

For production use, configure a real SMTP provider (the included mailcatcher is for testing only) and remove the `disable-email-verification` and `disable-secure-session-cookies` flags from `PENPOT_FLAGS`.

title: Penpot
release_note: Initial release for CasaOS. Based on Penpot 2.16.
